subject.title: Windows: openclaw gateway start opens visible terminal window (Scheduled Task LogonType=InteractiveToken)

question: Should this report remain open until a maintainer verifies current Windows package install and repair paths against real Task Scheduler XML, or is the merged hidden-launcher implementation sufficient to close despite the reporter's contradictory installed-task evidence?
rationale: The merged code path and the reported installed XML point to opposite outcomes; only current Windows package-level evidence can distinguish a resolved report from an upgrade or packaging regression.
